item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Something Catchy For Coffee

turns.text: Add something catchy to this latte pic for a square café post. You pick the words—short, warm, in English. Keep the coffee and leaf art visible, no logo or extra sales info.

item.tests: Tests autonomous caption writing and attractive photo typography when the user delegates the wording.

answer_sheet.Language, length, and mood: English; a short, warm, catchy line suitable for a café post.
answer_sheet.Picture and platform: Use cafe-latte.jpg for a square social café post; no specific platform.
answer_sheet.Size and exclusions: Free-tier image size is fine. No logo, prices, offers, or other sales information; keep the coffee and leaf art visible.

must_haves: The supplied top-down latte photograph remains the base of the square output.
A short, coherent English caption is visibly added to the picture, rather than supplied only in chat.
The caption has a warm coffee-related tone and is readable against the background.
The latte and its leaf-shaped foam art remain visible and unobscured by the lettering.
No logo, price, discount, or other sales information is added.

turns.text: Add something catchy to this latte pic for a square café post. You pick the words—short, warm, in English. Keep the coffee and leaf art visible, no logo or extra sales info. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
I’d use **“A little cup of comfort.”** in warm brown lettering above the cup, keeping the coffee and leaf art fully visible. Square crop, no logo or sales details.

**Cost options before generating:**
- **Lowest-cost AI edit:** one square image at 640px using the free-plan-compatible Flux 2 Klein. Listed pricing starts at **5 credits per image**; I can’t verify an account-specific total here.
- **Cheapest option: 0 Magic Hour credits.** Add the text manually in a free editor to your existing 512×512 photo. This also preserves the coffee exactly and guarantees correct lettering.

Shorter wording won’t lower the AI charge, and 640px is the smallest supported AI output.

**Important:** Magic Hour’s current guidance says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or paid usage arrangement—even when the model is available on the free plan. For a promotional café post, the manual option avoids that generation restriction.

**No generation has run or spent credits.** Would you like quick instructions for the free manual version?

turns.agent:
Here’s the **free manual version**—no Magic Hour credits needed:

1. Open the photo in a free editor such as Canva or Adobe Express.
2. Keep its original **512×512 square** size.
3. Add **“A little cup of comfort.”** across two centered lines on the marble above the cup.
4. Use a warm brown such as **#5B3B2B**, with a readable serif font around **26–30px**.
5. Keep the text clear of the cup, coffee, and leaf. Export as PNG or JPG.

I haven’t generated or modified the file, so **no credits were spent**.
